deployment: in-process X-COM library or offline test process
errors: declared fail-closed status or test failure
responsibilities: If a storage append reports fewer bytes than requested (partial write) or a transient write/sync failure, the journal **shall** fail closed: it **shall** attempt to restore the last complete frame boundary (truncate to the last known-good offset) and, if it cannot, **shall** mark the journal unusable for further appends and report `PartialWrite`/`WriteFailed`; it **shall** never count a partial frame as a retained record.
